entities.summary: Tohir Yo‘ldosh (b. 1967-10-02, Namangan) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Namangan and Uzbekistan. Known in the fields of uzbekistan, military leaders & commanders, asia.
